prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: pixel RPG child Yuuki LEFT-facing locomotion sprite sheet for animation.
Input images: image 1 is the approved left walking appearance to preserve exactly; image 2 is the approved left running appearance; image 3 is the approved front design, supporting identity reference only.
Primary request: Create a clean sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT complete character drawings, FOUR columns by TWO rows, all facing screen LEFT. First row: a four-frame walking loop. Second row: a four-frame running loop. Use actual transparent background, no text, no grid, no halo, no weapons, no effects, no fragments.
Character: Yuuki, 9-year-old child, white long hair, red eyes, black hair bow with small cross, modest black-and-white dress with white short puff sleeves, white socks and black shoes. Same child proportions, same face, same costume details, same crisp pixel rendering as references. Not older, not bigger. Anatomical left wing BLACK (near/viewer-facing wing for these left views), anatomical right wing WHITE (far wing behind). Preserve these wing sides and silhouette through every pose.
Critical gait requirement: four genuinely different phases with opposite legs alternating, not repeated drawings of the same lead leg. Clearly show TWO separate legs and shoes in every drawing. Keep feet unobstructed below the skirt. The near leg has the full light socks and near black shoe; far leg can have subtle consistent shadow solely for depth identification.
WALK first row, left to right:
1 contact A: NEAR leg extended forward toward screen LEFT, far leg back toward RIGHT, both feet near ground.
2 passing A: NEAR foot moves BACK under pelvis and supports the body; FAR knee moves forward and bent lifted far foot passes near shin.
3 contact B: NEAR leg extended backward toward screen RIGHT, FAR leg forward toward LEFT. This must be the opposite support/contact from frame 1; visibly near shoe is on RIGHT this time.
4 passing B: FAR foot under pelvis supports body, NEAR bent knee moves forward toward LEFT, near lifted foot passes far shin. Loops to 1.
RUN second row, left to right:
1 contact A: near foot reaching LEFT to land, far leg bent back toward RIGHT, body slight forward lean, bent counter-swing arms.
2 flight A: near leg trails RIGHT behind body with heel bent up, far knee forward LEFT; BOTH feet airborne.
3 contact B: far foot reaching LEFT to land, near leg bent back RIGHT with near shoe visibly right, opposite arm swing to frame 1.
4 flight B: near knee forward LEFT, far leg trails RIGHT bent up; BOTH feet airborne, loops to 1.
Constraints: use a fixed straight-on left-facing 3/4 RPG side camera and absolutely stable character scale, hair/head shape, torso length, wings, dress. Subtle pose follow-through only, no zoom, no turn toward camera, no costume shifts. Head aligned near the same relative spot per cell, contact feet on common baseline; slight rise on airborne run poses only. Adequate empty transparent gutters around each full body so no hair, shoes or wing gets clipped. Do not fuse feet. Do not simulate motion through blur, distortions or stretching. Clean crisp pixels with existing shading. Four equally spaced columns, two equally spaced rows, no more characters.
